lines.notes: THE LINE PRINTS THREE CHECKBOXES AND `4c` ALONE IS NOT AN ADDRESS ON IT. Box 1 is Rollover, box 2 is QCD, and box 3 is the WRITE-IN: the instructions say “if another publication or instruction tells you to write a word or code next to line 4b, check box 3 on line 4c and enter that word or code on the entry space next to box 3”, and HFD is its named use. Three different marks, not three copies of one, so they are columns in the sense this map already uses for Schedule D line 1b — `columns_are: fields`, the default. A route naming only `4c` could not say WHICH box it ticks, and the buildsheet carried the distribution's dollar value there instead of a mark.

form.notes: Two printed pages. Lines 1a-11a are on page 1; 11b-38 on page 2. Line 25 carries no amount box - it is the caption over 25a-25d. Lines 3c, 4c, 5c, 6d, 7b, 12a-12d, 27b, 27c and 35c are checkbox lines carrying no amount. On 4c and 5c, checkbox 3 is printed with no label: it is an unlabeled write-in, the same pattern as line 16's third box - the 2025 instructions say to check it and write the word or code (e.g. 'HFD') in the entry space beside it. Line 3c's two boxes, by contrast, ARE labelled ('Line 3a' and 'Line 3b') and there is no write-in. Line 7b's second checkbox carries an ENTRY SPACE: the instructions say to check 'Includes child's capital gain or (loss)' and enter the amount from Form 8814, line 10, in that space, while the gain itself is included in the line 7a total. Line 6c (lump-sum election) is NOT new for 2025 - it is on the TY2024 form too. Standard deduction amounts printed in the left margin for 2025: Single or Married filing separately $15,750; Married filing jointly or Qualifying surviving spouse $31,500; Head of household $23,625.
